name: Varthi K N
story:
My name is Varthi K N, and I never imagined I would have to tell my story like this.

I come from a small, poor family. My father is a daily wage worker, and my mother does household work in nearby homes. We have always lived a simple life, managing somehow with what little we earn. But everything changed when I was diagnosed with a brain tumor.

It started with severe headaches and dizziness. At first, we ignored it because we could not afford hospital visits. But when I fainted one day, my family rushed me to a government hospital. After tests, the doctors told us I needed urgent surgery. The cost was far beyond anything we could ever afford.

Since then, my life has become a struggle between pain and hope. Some days, the headaches are unbearable, and I can barely get out of bed. My parents try to stay strong, but I see the fear in their eyes. We have already borrowed money from relatives, but it is still not enough.

I want to live. I want to support my family someday and give them a better life.

I am humbly asking for help. Any small contribution can bring me closer to treatment and a second chance at life. Please help me fight this battle.
author: email
